head: 8a1d01bb47a3160ab90f859d43deeedcd77c51e3
notes: 14 mutations, 14 killed, 0 survivors. Removing the idle timeout HANGS rather than failing — the hang is both the kill and the production symptom. Found that mint_stream_token is deterministic in (uid,exp), so two mints in the same second are byte-identical and single-use now refuses the second as a replay; per-uid concurrency 1 would refuse it anyway. All guard state is per-process, so the real ceiling is N instances x 24.
